evidence: Healthy apple leaf. Many PlantDoc images are isolated stock-photo leaves; 'healthy' means no disease label, not an expert check.
Cedar apple rust is Gymnosporangium juniperi-virginianae; 'apple rust' can also cover other Gymnosporangium rusts.
Bacterial spot is Xanthomonas; 'leaf spot' is a generic symptom name with other causes.
Gray leaf spot, Cercospora zeae-maydis (and C. zeina).
Northern leaf blight is Exserohilum turcicum; 'corn leaf blight' also covers southern corn leaf blight (Bipolaris maydis).
Common rust is Puccinia sorghi; 'corn rust' also covers southern rust (Puccinia polysora).
Powdery mildew of cucurbits (Podosphaera xanthii and related).
Tomato mosaic virus; the PlantDoc name does not say which mosaic-causing virus, so visual labels may be mixed.
